column1: • Efficiency is king: FGA -1 and FTA -1 mean a missed shot costs more here than in a standard points league.
• A 45% shooter on high volume can bleed points; a 60% big on the same volume compounds.
• STL and BLK at 4x make defensive specialists materially more valuable than their ESPN ranking implies.
• AST at 2x rewards high-usage playmakers, but TO at -2 claws a chunk of it back.
• An offensive rebound counts twice (REB + OREB), so rebounding bigs are over-rewarded.
• ESPN does NOT project OREB, DREB, PF, DD or TD — those projection columns are intentionally blank.
